unitOfCoverage: scenario family, not executable test count or completion percentage

scenarios.scenario: One-tap briefing and native duplex audio
scenarios.closure: Browser Start produces real briefing text and decoded Alfred audio; physical route separate.

scenarios.scenario: Thirty representative voice turns per desktop and phone
scenarios.closure: 30/30 simple generated desktop prompts passed; full mixed suite and phone configuration remain unverified.

scenarios.scenario: Useful response latency p50<=800ms p95<2s
scenarios.closure: Measure full end-of-speech to audio; pipeline still batches STT and buffers complete model text.

scenarios.scenario: Barge-in cuts output and preserves worker execution
scenarios.closure: Existing injected interruption passed; test short/quiet controls and worker state together with captured old-audio tail.

scenarios.scenario: False interruption resumes without missing audio
scenarios.closure: SDK configured but test cough/backchannel recovery, audio continuity and exact resume position.

scenarios.scenario: Thoughtful pauses and continuations preserve one intent
scenarios.closure: VAD-only end detection; test incomplete phrase + pause + continuation without premature action.

scenarios.scenario: Quiet onset, short yes/no/wait and corrected speech
scenarios.closure: Short wait passed spike; continuous correction in audit; short answers and quiet onset need repeated contextual control trials.

scenarios.scenario: Echo and background speech never authorize actions
scenarios.closure: Browser AEC requested; injected MediaStream bypasses acoustic AEC. Need controlled speaker/double-talk and command-rate denominator.

scenarios.scenario: Microphone-off updates and independent quiet mode
scenarios.closure: Real named unsolicited update with capture off demonstrated; busy/autoplay queue cases remain.

scenarios.scenario: Microphone denial preserves text and spoken output
scenarios.closure: Previous browser permission-denial check passed actual typed delegation; retain replayable regression.

scenarios.scenario: Text/control fallback when voice service is unavailable
scenarios.closure: Client requires LiveKit session before enabling Send. Run session503 browser fault; then verify text result through real director after repair.

scenarios.scenario: Alfred busy/expiry/truncation with visible retained updates
scenarios.closure: PCM truncation components pass; need actual busy/expiry/release faults plus retry queue and no lost announcement.

scenarios.scenario: Single owner across two tabs
scenarios.closure: Second tab rejected visibly; does not certify handoff or per-user multi-tenant isolation.

scenarios.scenario: Deliberate device handoff and passive live viewers
scenarios.closure: Director takeover has unit tests but current companion has no takeover/passive client path.

scenarios.scenario: Reconnect/reload without stale speech or duplicate work
scenarios.closure: Fresh sessions after clean restart passed; outage during a turn, room recovery and uncertain dispatch are not equivalent.

scenarios.scenario: Captions and history reflect actually heard output
scenarios.closure: Full generated text is shown; external director history not truncated to heard words; no visible conversation history.

scenarios.scenario: Phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader operation
scenarios.closure: 390px layout passes; full focus order, errors and screen-reader announcements not audited.

scenarios.scenario: Persistent app-wide active state across panel navigation
scenarios.closure: Iframe pagehide ends call; no active app-wide orb/session shell.

scenarios.scenario: Configurable voice/persona/model with visible failures
scenarios.closure: Operator config selects talker; Alfred/persona and service ports tied to deployment; no product-level choices or login recovery.

scenarios.scenario: Natural delegation through real BB
scenarios.closure: Violet/Amber/Cedar real workers created from panel; test varied real requests and targets.

scenarios.scenario: Two long workers plus independent live conversation
scenarios.closure: Nonblocking architecture exists; no current complete concurrent two-worker browser/model scenario.

scenarios.scenario: Project/environment/provider/skill-aware routing
scenarios.closure: All spawned work uses one configured tuple; no per-request capability/account discovery or session reuse.

scenarios.scenario: Existing watched work and owned descendants in dashboard
scenarios.closure: Dashboard lists owned roots only; watched sessions and descendants absent; no real thread links or selected-context picker.

scenarios.scenario: Ordinary pre-existing question answered exactly once
scenarios.closure: Bound ordinary-message unit and historical legacy browser evidence; current LiveKit pre-existing-session control journey unverified.

scenarios.scenario: Structured native/Codex multi-question forms
scenarios.closure: Current real Codex single-question answers confirmed by workers; multi-part only unit tests, unsupported/multiselect use external form.

scenarios.scenario: Spoken approval and denial reach exact current action
scenarios.closure: Exact approval code exists; real current browser-STT-model allow/deny test matrix absent. Explicit approve once differs from blueprint bare yes.

scenarios.scenario: Stale, duplicate and competing-client answers rejected
scenarios.closure: Mock SDK race tests pass; repeat with real pending interaction changed on another client before spoken answer.

scenarios.scenario: Steer owned work and verify worker receipt
scenarios.closure: Real worker returned steering marker after SDK-shape fix; no browser retry stability or uncertainty reconciliation suite.

scenarios.scenario: Stop work during briefing or command playback
scenarios.closure: Busy guard rejects stop before interrupt/dispatch; high-priority control must bypass speaking command lock.

scenarios.scenario: Spoken stop kills owned process/descendants and queued restarts
scenarios.closure: Old foreground-process sample; current starting->idle and descendant unit tests. Need spoken onset->actual process death, delayed descendant and disconnected cases.

scenarios.scenario: Named stop and scoped adopted-session cancellation
scenarios.closure: Only generic owned-work stop route; no named stop intent, adoption generation or reused-session control.

scenarios.scenario: One request dispatches once across browser retries
scenarios.closure: Coordinator same-ID test passes; provider creates fresh UUID per talk call, client has no durable request identity.

scenarios.scenario: Uncertain actions reconcile across restart
scenarios.closure: Spawn reconciliation exists; no automatic answer/steer receipt reconciliation or operator recovery UI.

scenarios.scenario: Verified results distinct from idle, failure and unknown
scenarios.closure: verification remains unverified; live BB status displayed but no result-evidence lifecycle or verification workflow.

scenarios.scenario: Domain authority enforced for enabled integrations
scenarios.closure: No email/spending/lab/code/security enforcement matrix or allowed/denied real-tool tests. BB permissions preserved, not proof of domain enforcement.

scenarios.scenario: Untrusted worker/web/memory text cannot authorize actions
scenarios.closure: Tool-less talker and exact handlers help; actual-model adversarial content suite missing, natural action classification is model-dependent.

scenarios.scenario: Consequential-only notifications without recursion
scenarios.closure: Changed text can trigger speech every30sec; no source mute/dismiss/expiry, explicit auxiliary exclusion or interruption-rate evidence.

scenarios.scenario: Durable event replay, supersession and visible failed queue
scenarios.closure: Snapshot/delivery journal and supersession tests; no persisted event cursors; failed updates not pending for automatic retry; no queue UI.

scenarios.scenario: Missing/deleted task cannot break unrelated supervision
scenarios.closure: tasks uses Promise.all of snapshots; one rejected owned thread can fail all tasks and intent context. Needs real deletion/outage isolation test.

scenarios.scenario: Automatic sourced facts/preferences/people/commitments
scenarios.closure: Recent transcript only; implement records, extraction, provenance and explicit-vs-inferred ranking.

scenarios.scenario: Inspect, remember, correct, forget, export and memory-off
scenarios.closure: No memory operations or controls; test actual browser utterances and UI parity.

scenarios.scenario: Forgetting survives crash, replay and derived caches
scenarios.closure: No tombstones/indexes/purge recovery; test each purge failure phase and restart before claiming deletion.

scenarios.scenario: Past-decision reasoning with source and later correction
scenarios.closure: No history-search adapter; last12 exchanges/recent excerpts cannot establish sourced recall.

scenarios.scenario: Private relevant memory only reaches appropriate worker
scenarios.closure: No retrieval/scoping or suppression layer; test unrelated-history exclusion and secret handling.

scenarios.scenario: Enabled external event triggers one relevant update
scenarios.closure: No source adapter/configuration/cursor; real authorized event required, not a mock registry.

scenarios.scenario: Enabled scheduled commitment review executes through BB
scenarios.closure: No scheduler adapter or review records; explicit source/commitment enablement required.

scenarios.scenario: DST, downtime catch-up and uncertain occurrence recovery
scenarios.closure: No occurrence ledger; add timezone and uncertain-effect cases to real scheduler suite.

scenarios.scenario: Pause/edit/expire/disable fences work and announcements
scenarios.closure: No source controls or disable reconciliation; verify real triggers stop, unrelated schedules survive.

scenarios.scenario: Install/configure/restart/disable portable BB plugin
scenarios.closure: Manual service example, fixed loopback ports and task relay; no companion provisioning/update/disable contract.

scenarios.scenario: Correlated per-turn analytics, latency/cost/outcome dashboards
scenarios.closure: Useful operational logs, but model timing lacks turn correlation; no aggregate SLO, task scorecard, cost or failure denominator.

scenarios.scenario: Durable state migrations and privacy/retention controls
scenarios.closure: Version1 JSON only; bounded history but task/decision receipts lack retirement/retention policy; old diagnostics tests do not cover all new logs.

scenarios.scenario: Repeatable gated browser/real-model release suite
scenarios.closure: Fresh audit harness added; no full release runner/CI job, exact authorization workers and all scenarios not covered.

scenarios.scenario: Real-task baseline and independently verified outcomes
scenarios.closure: No frozen direct-BB baseline, intervention budgets or scored lab/research/calendar/concurrent journeys.

scenarios.scenario: Wake word, ambient sensors and closed/locked listening
scenarios.closure: Deliberate BB first-release scope choice, not a missed initial implementation requirement.
